Klasse EncryptionUtils

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.utils.EncryptionUtils
public final class EncryptionUtils extends Object
Provides the common cryptographic primitives used by the SEDAP-Express utility classes.

This class owns the single shared SecureRandom instance used for key-pair generation, KEM encapsulation, salt generation, key generation, and IV/nonce generation. Other utility classes must use random rather than creating additional random generators.

The class implements HKDF-SHA-256 for high-entropy DH/ECDH/KEM shared secrets and Argon2id for password-based key derivation. It also provides AES-CFB, AES-CTR, and AES-GCM encryption helpers. CFB and CTR do not authenticate ciphertext; AES-GCM should be preferred when integrity protection is required.

Seit:
1.5.5
Autor:
Volker Voß

    • generateCounterBasedIV

      public static byte[] generateCounterBasedIV()
      Creates a process-local, counter-based 128-bit IV for AES-CTR. The layout is a 32-bit process-session identifier, a 64-bit monotonic counter, and four reserved zero bytes.

      This construction is unique only within the current process and counter lifetime. Do not reuse the same AES key with this IV scheme across processes or independent directions unless uniqueness is guaranteed externally. Prefer separately derived keys per direction/session.

      Gibt zurück:
      16-byte counter-based AES-CTR IV
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the local IV counter is exhausted

    • generateCounterBasedIV

      public static byte[] generateCounterBasedIV(int sessionIdentifier)
      Creates a process-local, counter-based 128-bit IV for AES-CTR using a caller-supplied session identifier. The layout is the 32-bit session identifier, a 64-bit monotonic counter, and four reserved zero bytes.

      The counter is shared with the no-argument overload. The same key/session identifier must not be used by another process or transmission direction unless IV uniqueness is guaranteed.

      Parameter:
      sessionIdentifier - 32-bit identifier associated with the cryptographic session
      Gibt zurück:
      16-byte counter-based AES-CTR IV
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the local IV counter is exhausted

    • generateRandomIV

      public static byte[] generateRandomIV()
      Generates a random 128-bit IV for AES-CFB or AES-CTR using the shared random generator.
      Gibt zurück:
      a new 16-byte IV

    • generateNonce

      public static byte[] generateNonce()
      Generates a random 96-bit nonce for AES-GCM using the shared random generator.

      Random nonces provide probabilistic uniqueness. Use independently derived traffic keys for each direction and avoid excessive message counts with one key; nonce reuse under a GCM key compromises security.

      Gibt zurück:
      a new random 12-byte AES-GCM nonce

    • generateNonce

      public static byte[] generateNonce(int sessionIdentifier)
      Generates a deterministic 96-bit AES-GCM nonce consisting of a 32-bit session identifier and a 64-bit process-local monotonic counter.

      Do not use the same AES key and session identifier in multiple processes or directions. The caller must ensure that a session identifier is not reused with the same key after a process restart.

      Parameter:
      sessionIdentifier - 32-bit identifier of the cryptographic session
      Gibt zurück:
      12-byte nonce containing the session identifier and counter
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if the local nonce counter is exhausted

    • deriveKeyFromSharedSecretHKDFSHA256

      public static byte[] deriveKeyFromSharedSecretHKDFSHA256(byte[] sharedSecret, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt, String info)
      Derives an AES-128 or AES-256 key from high-entropy shared secret material using HKDF-SHA-256. The same secret, salt, context string, and output length must be supplied by both peers.
      Parameter:
      sharedSecret - nonempty raw shared secret from DH, ECDH, ML-KEM, or FrodoKEM
      aesKeyLength - requested AES key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - HKDF salt; between 16 and 1024 bytes for this general-purpose method
      info - nonempty UTF-8 context label used for domain separation and protocol binding
      Gibt zurück:
      derived AES key, 16 bytes for AES-128 or 32 bytes for AES-256
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the shared secret, salt, key length, or context label is null, empty, or outside its permitted range

    • deriveKeyFromPasswordArgon2id

      public static byte[] deriveKeyFromPasswordArgon2id(char[] password, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt)
      Derives an AES-128 or AES-256 key from a password using Argon2id version 1.3, 64 MiB of memory, three iterations, and one lane. The returned key is derived from the password and supplied salt.

      The salt and Argon2 parameters must be persisted with the protected data so the same key can be derived later. The caller remains responsible for clearing the supplied password array.

      Parameter:
      password - password characters; must not be null or empty
      aesKeyLength - requested AES key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - Argon2id salt; between 16 and 1024 bytes
      Gibt zurück:
      derived AES key, 16 bytes for AES-128 or 32 bytes for AES-256
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the password, salt, or key length is null, empty, or outside its permitted range

    • encrypt_AES_CFB

      public static byte[] encrypt_AES_CFB(byte[] originalData, byte[] key) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchPaddingException, IllegalBlockSizeException, BadPaddingException, InvalidKeyException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Encrypts arbitrary plaintext bytes with AES-CFB/NoPadding and prefixes a random 16-byte IV. CFB does not authenticate ciphertext; use AES-GCM or an independent authentication mechanism if tamper detection is required.
      Parameter:
      originalData - plaintext bytes; may be empty but must not be null
      key - AES-128 or AES-256 key bytes
      Gibt zurück:
      IV || ciphertext, with a 16-byte IV prefix
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the plaintext or key is invalid
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if AES is unavailable
      NoSuchPaddingException - if CFB/NoPadding is unavailable
      IllegalBlockSizeException - if the cipher rejects the input length
      BadPaddingException - if the cipher reports a padding error
      InvalidKeyException - if the AES key is rejected
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the IV is rejected

    • decrypt_AES_CFB

      public static byte[] decrypt_AES_CFB(byte[] data, byte[] key) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchPaddingException, InvalidKeyException, IllegalBlockSizeException, BadPaddingException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Decrypts an AES-CFB message in the format 16-byte IV || ciphertext. CFB does not authenticate ciphertext, so successful decryption does not prove integrity.
      Parameter:
      data - encrypted message with its 16-byte IV prefix
      key - AES-128 or AES-256 key bytes
      Gibt zurück:
      decrypted plaintext bytes
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the data is too short or the key is invalid
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if AES is unavailable
      NoSuchPaddingException - if CFB/NoPadding is unavailable
      InvalidKeyException - if the AES key is rejected
      IllegalBlockSizeException - if the cipher rejects the input length
      BadPaddingException - if the cipher reports a padding error
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the IV is rejected

      Decrypts an AES-GCM message in the format 12-byte nonce || ciphertext || 128-bit authentication tag. The JCA cipher verifies the tag before returning plaintext.

      InvalidKeyException - if the AES key is rejected
      IllegalBlockSizeException - if the cipher rejects the input length
      BadPaddingException - if authentication fails or the cipher reports a padding error
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the nonce or GCM parameters are rejected
